notes.title: The Lair of the Giant Cat
notes.content:
In this game update, you can expect:


  A new underground location
  A new bad ending
  A new good ending
  New items and quests


Pack your backpack, grab as many energy drinks as you can, and head down into the lair of the giant cat, Fred. You’ll finally get to use that cassette tape in Fred the cat's room! 
http://wildgames.net/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/002-1024x594.png
